nom: Manuka Honey Exfoliating Facial Scrub - Microdermabrasion Face Exfoliant

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports no adverse reaction and says it helps remove dead skin and improve the look of spots.
segments.dry: One reviewer with long-standing dry patches on her forehead, eyebrows and cheeks, who says nothing else had worked, reports a dramatic improvement within two days, with skin feeling hydrated and foundation no longer flaking off.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, report no redness, irritation or flare-ups and say it leaves skin soft without stripping it; one dissenting review says the granules are too large, sharp and rough for sensitive skin types.
segments.mature: Most reviewers with mature skin report brighter, healthier-looking skin and fewer blackheads with regular use; one dissenting 66-year-old reviewer says the scrub particles were too large and it did not deliver the moisturizing she was looking for.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers with mature or aging skin report a brighter, smoother, slightly moisturizing finish and possible firming with regular use; one dissenting 66-year-old reviewer found the scrub particles too large and unhelpful for the moisturizing results she wanted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it leaves skin hydrated rather than dry or tight, including one whose long-standing dry patches improved within two days and another who says it does not over-dry skin with regular use; one dissenting review from a 66-year-old says it did not deliver the moisturizing benefit she was looking for.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report no redness or flare-ups after use, including one who normally fears a fire-engine-red allergic reaction from scrub products and another whose facial redness and flushing eased as related bumps improved.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers who describe eczema-prone or easily inflamed skin report no irritation and say the lack of added fragrance helps avoid triggering a reaction.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report visibly reduced dark spots and acne scarring with continued use, including one who says a noticeable difference appeared after just the second use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer blackheads and calmer breakouts with regular use, including one whose stubborn acne and acne marks improved and another whose blackheads cleared almost instantly; one dissenting review describes a severe, unprecedented breakout across the face that worsened when use resumed after a week off, despite the reviewer never having had acne before.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports no adverse reaction and describes the scrub as helping keep her pores clear without a heavy or greasy feel.

aspects.libelle: Container is much smaller than expected
Leaves skin noticeably soft and smooth
Packaging sometimes arrives damaged or opened
Doubles well as a leave-on face mask
A little product covers the whole face

extraits.texte: Beware! It may cause severe acne. I never had acne not even in my teenage years. I sometimes get one or 2 at the most, during my period... I bought it to remove dead skin and healthier looking skin as Im getting closer to my 40s and now I have a bumps all over my face that look like a breakout. Ive never experienced something like this before! :( I stopped using it, to give my face a break away from any products for about a week -even took away my moisturizer- and when I used it again the breakout reappeared even worse. I might add a picture later to show before and after. Im Very worried and hoping this heals fast.

extraits.titre: It did absolutely nothing for my skin, especially for as expensive as it is.
extraits.texte: Toted as a scrub but I found the "scubbers" to be too large and useless for buffing the skin. As well I have 66 year old skin and was looking for something to help with moisturizing. It did not do that. Lastly its extremely messy. The scrubber particles are so large they remain in the bottom of the tub when I am finished and I end up having to scrub down the tub. Additionally I spend 5 minutes rinsing it to get it out of my hairline. I've used it both as a scrub and as a mask and find it useless either way.

When you first open the 2 oz jar it looks like there is product missing that goes all the way to the bottom of the jar. It is definitely not for sensitive skin types since the granules are particularly larger, sharper and rougher than St. Ives. Compared to St. Ives the product has less granular texture over surface area. There is a peculiar residue that stays on your face after using this product. It can easily come off using a toner with alcohol. It does not come off while repeatedly washing the face though. The scent smells like honey mixed with chemicals but it is not overbearing.

I've only used this once so far but I could tell the difference right away from other exfoliating products. Most are really bad for my skin, being fairly sensitive with mild rosacea, but this one didn't leave my face all red and irritated. I used it as a face mask, and when I washed it off it felt like it was moisturizing my face instead of drying it out. The walnut that acts as an exfoliator is gentle and doesn't make you feel like you're scrubbing your skin away trying to wash the mask off. The one down side I can find for the product (other than a fragrant, natural odor that I can deal with) is the price for a small container. But that's how it is getting organic products most of the time unfortunately. I would say it is worth it. You probably will only feel the need to use this once a week, so for one person it could last a while. We'll see how it works over the next few tries, but I think I will be buying again. Thank you EraOrganics!

extraits.titre: Helping with my Keratosis Pilaris Rubra Faceii
extraits.texte: So far I love this product! I have been using this in conjunction with some other Era Organic products, and have to say, I am pleased with the results so far. To give you a background on my skin, I have Keratosis Pilaris Rubra Faceii. If you are unfamiliar with it, it is where your skin is rough, and bumpy due to hair follicles getting plugged up with keratin, along with redness and flushing on the face. I have tried various products over the years. My recent skincare regime was using an exfoliating cleanser with AHA/BHA (acids). However, my face was feeling very dried out, especially now that it is the winter. My skin has days where it looks much worse, and flairs up so it looks very red. Usually if I can combat the bumps, it helps combat the redness. I started using the Era Organics Cleanser & Relief for my skin. I especially like that it contains manuka honey, since I have been prone to break out in the past as well. Although I was feeling like my skin was getting the nutrients it needs, I felt like it needed a little more. So, I decided to try the microdermabrasion scrub. I love it!! After reading other reviews I was worried it wouldn't give me the exfoliation I needed... but it does. I actually use this once a day, if possible, since I do have such rough skin. extraits.titre: If you have dry skin buy this!!!
extraits.texte: This is the wife writing a review .. I have suffered with dry skin for a long time. Dry patches on my forehead , in my eyebrows , and sometimes on my cheeks. Currently it got to the point where I couldn’t wear makeup because how bad the dry patches were . Every month I was buying new skincare products to try and also trying every home remedy you could think of . NONE of them worked! I even tried eating a plant based diet and drinking more water. I took a chance and bought one last product to see if maybe it will work.. and I’m so glad I did! I AM OBSESSED with era organic. After two days of using I noticed a change! my skin did a total transformation. I never thought I would see the day that I say my skin feels hydrated IM SHOCKED. My skin feels like it can breath again and literally is baby smooth and flawless . I am able to wear makeup again and able to put on foundation without it flaking off my face . I honestly don’t even want to wear foundation because how great my skin looks and feels. When I thought I lost hope I found era organics THANK YOU!
I saw a big difference agterthe 2nd use. I had dark spots, small acne scars and dull skin. This really brighten my skin and removed dark spots and acne scars.
